approval.source: current user message following the concrete rerun proposal
approval.scope: Rerun-based twenty-pair comparison and separate finite preparation allowance as proposed and summarized in the preceding assistant message.

supersedes.rule: Distinct primary run IDs required by original Plan254-08
supersedes.replacement: Register each measured full-workflow invocation by (run_id, run_attempt), with attempt-specific queue/start timing, source/origin checks, costs, and immutable outcome.

method.sample_identity: Use (run_id, run_attempt) for separately preregistered full-workflow invocations, instead of requiring forty distinct run IDs.
method.baseline_execution: Rerun the original baseline PR workflow; GitHub documents preservation of original GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_REF. Verify actual workflow, checkout SHA/tree and native artifacts before accepting any sample.
method.candidate_execution: Publish and review an exact candidate PR source/merge/workflow, establish its initial real-PR run, then use registered full reruns of that fixed event/source. Stop if source equivalence cannot be proven.
method.timing: Bind a queued attempt before its outcome, retain request/queue timestamps, derive each attempt wait from its own new invocation rather than the original historical run created_at. If an authenticated attempt-specific queued time is unavailable, do not treat this method as feasible or start the comparison window.
method.failure_and_cost_policy: Each reserved sample retains its failure/cancellation and all its own retry/job costs. A later attempt never replaces an unfavorable reserved sample. Primary run cumulative costs must not be counted repeatedly across samples.
machinery_required: Attempt-scoped registration and raw attempt acquisition
Attempt-specific queue/wait and cost derivation tests
Same baseline archive, threshold and no-replacement protections

unchanged_controls.balanced_order: ten baseline-first pairs and ten candidate-first pairs
unchanged_controls.runner_images: compatible actual pair images; disclose historical drift

recipe: One full original-baseline rerun to prove original checkout/workflow and warm that fixed PR cache context
One initial reviewed candidate real-PR run to prove candidate source/merge/workflow and warm its fixed PR cache context
preparation_budget.includes: Registration/retrieval/watch traffic; one watcher per run, interval60; stop at core<=250 and any403/429.
preparation_budget.does_not_renew: Any Phase253 allowance or spent sample

raw_retention: Capture and preserve every completed attempt before requesting another rerun; GitHub artifacts from earlier attempts may become inaccessible. Verify durable bytes/read-back before continuation. No artifact deletion or source repair is authorized.
historical_record: Keep original Phase252 contract/archive, blocked Phase254 contract/proof/summary, and original proposal byte-for-byte; write a separate amended execution contract and continuation.
disclosure: This is a rerun-based fixed-source experiment, not forty new-PR scheduler observations; report that limitation.
GitHub docs state a maximum of50reruns and eligibility within30days. Baseline attempt1 currently leaves room, but rerun availability must be rechecked before execution.
Old-cache accessibility, actual runner images, retained frozen producer checkout and authenticated attempt-specific queue time remain prerequisites; no hosted success is yet proven.
If these prerequisites fail, retain a blocker without spending measured samples or silently switching to a different baseline.

Any approved amendment is recorded as a change after implementation; never report that the original forty-distinct-PR-family method was executed unchanged or claim rerun samples establish new-PR scheduling performance.
